parameters.name: Backend
parameters.description: The IP address or domain name of the origin server that corresponds to the domain name.

parameters.name: CnameEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether public cloud disaster recovery is enabled. Valid values:

- **true**: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

- **false**: Public cloud disaster recovery is not enabled.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
